exposure: heart disease (subdivided by mWHO classification classes and Class X)
cohort: The study included 197 pregnancies with heart disease that occurred between June 2013 and December 2022.
finding: There were significant variations in outcomes based on cardiac problems, with Class X and Class B heart disease having much higher rates of cardiac complications and caesarean sections, respectively.
mod_finding: Class B heart disease was associated with much higher rates of caesarean sections.
